verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a public API and SDK surface that covers many UI workflows: querying data via SDKs, the Metrics API, scores via API/SDK, experiments via SDK alongside experiments via UI, custom evaluation workflows via API/SDKs, plus a CLI and an MCP server. A hands-on user also confirms the OpenAPI spec is practical to implement. However, nothing states or shows that every UI action has an API equivalent, and one user found the trace retrieval API too slow for bulk scanning and queried the database directly. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or evidence of full UI-to-API parity, API coverage for UI-only areas such as dashboards, annotation queues and prompt editing, a discoverable API reference, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
